title: Final temperature answer
description: Essential: Must state the final ambient temperature as T = (4/3)T₀ or equivalent.

title: Final pressure answer
description: Essential: Must state the final gas pressure as 2p or equivalent.

title: Gas law application
description: Important: Must apply Gay-Lussac's law (isobaric process) correctly to relate temperature and volume changes during heating.

title: Pressure equilibrium setup
description: Important: Must recognize that gas pressure equals atmospheric pressure plus mercury column pressure, and account for the doubling of mercury height.

title: Isothermal process reasoning
description: Important: Must apply Boyle's law (isothermal process) correctly to relate pressure and volume changes during mercury injection.

title: Volume relationships
description: Optional: Explicitly states that volumes are proportional to column lengths (V = S·h) and uses the given 3h/4 relationship.

title: Process identification
description: Optional: Clearly identifies the two distinct processes: isothermal compression then isobaric expansion.

title: Sign error in pressure
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly adds or subtracts mercury pressure relative to atmospheric pressure (e.g., p - p' instead of p + p').

title: Volume ratio inversion
description: Pitfall: Inverts the volume ratio when applying gas laws (e.g., uses V₁/V₂ instead of V₂/V₁ for temperature calculation).
